tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search the Applivery documentation by keyword or phrase. Returns matching pages with title, canonical URL, a highlighted snippet, docType ('guides' or 'api'), platform, breadcrumb and in-page headings. Use this first to discover pages, then read one with get_doc_page. For non-developer questions prefer docType 'guides'.

locale.description: Language filter, e.g. 'en' or 'es'. Omit to search all languages.

section.description: Restrict results to a documentation section.

excludeSection.description: Exclude a documentation section from results.

docType.description: Filter by corpus: 'guides' (product documentation, for admins and end users) or 'api' (REST API reference, for developers). Omit to search both.

tools.name: get_doc_page
tools.description: Fetch the full Markdown content of a documentation page. Pass either `url` (typically a URL returned by search_docs) or `slug` plus `locale`. Returns clean Markdown; very long pages are truncated at `maxChars` with a note.

url.description: A docs.applivery.com page URL, typically copied from a search_docs result.

slug.description: Path after the locale, e.g. 'device-management/getting-started'. Used with locale when url is not given.

locale.description: Locale for the slug, e.g. 'en' (default en).

maxChars.description: Truncate the page after this many characters (default 80000). Raise it if a page arrives truncated.

tools.name: get_api_endpoint
tools.description: Get the machine-readable OpenAPI definition of one Applivery REST API endpoint: method, path, baseUrl, security, parameters, requestBody and responses — fully dereferenced, no $refs. Pass the `url` or `slug` of an API reference page; find those with search_docs using docType 'api'. Use this instead of get_doc_page when you need to construct or validate an actual API request.

url.description: A docs.applivery.com API reference page URL, e.g. from a search_docs result with docType 'api'.

slug.description: Path after the locale, e.g. 'api/android/web-apps/delete-web-app'. Used with locale when url is not given.

locale.description: Locale for the slug, e.g. 'en' (default en).

tools.name: list_doc_sections
tools.description: List the top-level documentation sections and landing pages from the site's curated index (llms.txt). Use for orientation, then drill in with search_docs or get_doc_page.

section.description: Optional filter on section name or title.
